title: Grateful Dead Live at Student Union Ballroom, U. Utah on 1969-04-12
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with classic analog hiss captures a strong ’69 set highlighted by Dark Star, The Eleven and a blazing Lovelight despite some cuts.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its adventurous early‑’70 vibe – a fiery Dark Star, scorching The Eleven, a hot Lovelight and solid Dew, He Was a Friend of Mine and St. Stephen.  The SBD source retains the warm analog hiss that many fans love, though it suffers from noticeable splices, pitch drift and the missing Other One/Too sections.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4‑5 stars and highlight strong performances; recording issues are noted but not fatal, yielding an overall solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Classic analog hiss adds character; several reviewers note splices, pitch correction needs, and missing portions (Other One, Too) that create audible gaps.

standout_songs: He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early set is loose and experimental with jokes and jam‑heavy moments; the second set builds into intense improvisations, though curfew‑related cuts truncate some material.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as agitated by a non‑dancing crowd, delivering strong guitar tone and energetic playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned for his odd character and the Yellow Dog story/jokes that pepper the performance.
